transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve just had this low, heavy feeling for a long time. Most days I feel kind of flat or empty, even when work is going okay or people are being nice to me. It’s like I’m still down anyway.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two years and two months now. It started around the time that dashboard project at work put me more in the spotlight, and it just kind of never really lifted after that.
Do you find yourself enjoying things that you used to like before you started feeling this way?
I’m not totally sure. I haven’t really paid attention to it that way. Some things feel kind of muted, I guess, but I don’t know if I’d say I don’t enjoy them at all.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

I’m not really sure I’d call it losing interest. I still do some of the same things, but they don’t always feel like much. It’s more like everything feels kind of dulled down than me actively not wanting to do them.
Do you feel like you've been able to experience pleasure from activities or things that normally would bring you happiness?
I don’t know, honestly. Some things that should feel good still feel… okay, I guess, but I’m not sure I’d call it real pleasure. It’s hard for me to tell.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I worry about normal stuff sometimes, but I haven’t really paid close attention to whether it’s more than usual.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge?
I don’t really know. I wouldn’t say I’m on edge a lot, but I guess I might not always notice it. I have normal worries here and there, but nothing I can clearly point to.
Have you ever thought about hurting yourself?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve had clear thoughts like that, but I’d have to think about what you mean exactly.
Have you ever had thoughts that you'd be better off dead?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve felt really low at times, but I don’t know if I’d say I’ve specifically thought I’d be better off dead.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?
Not really, no. I haven’t noticed any big change in my weight. Maybe it goes up or down a little, but nothing significant that I can tell.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns since you started feeling this way?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed a clear change in my sleep pattern, at least nothing that stands out.
Do you feel like you've been moving more slowly than usual or having trouble sitting still?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed myself moving slower than usual, and I’m not especially restless or unable to sit still.
Have you had any thoughts about wanting to end your life?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I don’t think I’ve had clear thoughts about ending my life, no.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I feel guilty a lot, at least not in a way that stands out to me.
Have you had any thoughts about wanting to end your life recently?
Recently? No, I don’t think I’ve had thoughts like that.
Do you feel like you're unable to feel pleasure or interest in things that normally would bring you happiness?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed that specifically. Some things just feel kind of normal, I guess, but I wouldn’t say I’m completely unable to enjoy anything.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight since you started feeling this way?
No, I don’t think so. My weight’s been pretty much the same, as far as I’ve noticed.
Do you feel like you've been fidgeting more or having trouble staying still lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself fidgeting more than usual, and I don’t think I’ve had much trouble sitting still.
Have you gained a significant amount of weight since you started feeling this way?
No, I haven’t noticed any significant weight gain. My weight seems about the same to me.
Have you had any thoughts about wanting to end your life?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I don’t think I’ve had clear thoughts about wanting to end my life, no.
